messages:
Anna S: Just rolled out roles/permissions refactor to prod (03:10 UTC). Getting flagged by monitoring—multiple tenants reporting 'model:access_denied' and empty billing dashboard. Raising here so SRE + Auth can triage.
Priya (SRE): On it. Can you paste the rollout commit? Any KMS key policy changes included?
Anna S: Rollout: deploy/roles-refactor@sha:fa3b12. No KMS policy changes in this PR; only role normalization + attribute mapping. Snippet:
```yaml
roles:
  - name: model_reader
    maps_from: ["legacy_model_viewer", "viewer.model"]
``` 
Mike L - Support: Received two escalations from acme-corp and heliohealth. Both say they can still call generation but console shows 'no models' and billing page returns 403.
Jun K - Auth: Logs show token introspect OK, but authorization filter returned empty allowed_models for those tenants. Investigating mapping logic. Reproducer attached.
Jun K - Auth: Reproducer command:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models?tenant=acme-corp
# response: {"models": [] }
```
Elena - Security: Audit logs show role_mapping.apply events at 03:09:45 for acme-corp where legacy roles were folded into 'project_viewer' but missing 'model_read' attribute. Possible attribute rename bug.
Priya (SRE): If attribute is missing, runtime will filter models by permission and return empty list -> matches symptom. Can we hotfix mapping to reintroduce model_read for affected tenants? What's scope?
Anna S: Patch ready to go, we can patch mapping hook to fallback. Will push a canary to staging then prod if green.
Priya (SRE): For mitigation, enabling 'relaxed-role-filter' flag for affected tenant IDs (acme-corp, heliohealth) should restore console quickly. I'll apply via feature-flags console.
Mike L - Support: Please paste flag IDs so I can notify customers.
Priya (SRE): flag: ff::relaxed_role_filter; targets: ["tenant:acme-corp","tenant:heliohealth"]. Applied at 03:22 UTC. Confirming model list for acme-corp...
Jun K - Auth: Confirmed: models now returned for acme-corp. Running smoke for billing endpoint.
Jun K - Auth: Billing page returns 200 for heliohealth now. Looks fixed.
AuditBot: Role mapping change applied by Anna S (deploy/roles-refactor@fa3b12) -> rolled back mapping for affected tenants via ff::relaxed_role_filter at 03:22 UTC.
Anna S: Following up with postmortem and a one-line revert to mapping logic. Will add stronger unit tests for attribute fallthrough. Mike, please update tickets to say access restored and postmortem forthcoming.
Mike L - Support: Noted, will update both support cases and escalate for SLA credit review if needed. :thumbsup:
Elena - Security: Also scheduling a KMS policy review next week to ensure no surprises when role attributes propagate to key grants.
Priya (SRE): Closing thread once postmortem link is posted.
